name: Flatten layers – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: To flatten a selection of objects, right-click on it and select Flatten or use the keyboard shortcut: Mac: Option Shift F Windows: Alt Shift F

name: Use Figma products with a keyboard – Figma Learn - Help Center
